candidates.change_summary: Change the value requirement from 10 ether to 1 ether, so calls with 1 ether now succeed and calls with 10 ether revert.
Remove the timestamp check so multiple calls in the same block are allowed, which also changes the observable pastBlockTime after repeated calls.
Invert the timestamp comparison so the first call succeeds but subsequent calls in later blocks revert.
Remove the update of pastBlockTime so the public getter returns 0 forever and repeated calls within the same block succeed.
Invert the payout condition so funds are sent on every block number not divisible by 15 instead of divisible by 15.
Assign block.number instead of block.timestamp to pastBlockTime, changing the value exposed by the public getter.
Delete the statement `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` so pastBlockTime is never updated.
Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` with `pastBlockTime = block.number;` so a different value is stored.
Delete the `require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime);` guard so multiple calls in the same block are allowed.
Replace the equality check `msg.value == 10 ether` with `msg.value != 10 ether`, inverting which calls succeed.
Replace the payout condition `block.number % 15 == 0` with `block.number % 15 == 1`, changing when the payout occurs.
Delete the payout branch so no funds are ever transferred out.
